findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Joshua did not just happen…”
findings.source_quote: “approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed …”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace „מאושרים לפני אלוהים” with „רצויים לאלוהים” to convey being approved by God, not being happy or blessed.
findings.translation_quote: „מאושרים לפני אלוהים, פועלים שאינם צריכים להתבייש…”
